title: FrontierBase Chatbot Script API Reference
description: Machine-readable API grammar for the FrontierBase chat widget. Call format: window.FrontierBase(command, payload). Use this spec for crawlers and AI tools.

callFormat.description: command is a string; payload is an optional object. After load, window.FrontierBase.loaded === true. Before load, use the queue stub so commands are replayed.

snippet.note: Set the same pluginKey in var pluginKey and boot({ pluginKey }). data-plugin-key on the script tag is optional (not read by the SDK; useful in DevTools only).

commands.name: boot
commands.remarks: pluginKey required. Loads Console channel settings, then applies client overrides from the boot payload (locale, gaTrackingId, userEmail, userPhotoURL, etc.). Re-boot with the same pluginKey merges the payload like update.

commands.name: update
commands.remarks: Queued if called before boot. pluginKey change triggers re-boot. Use dataset_ids here to set the default RAG scope for init and message requests until changed again.

commands.name: open
commands.remarks: Optional dataset_ids per open (overrides update default for that session). Queued if called before boot.

boot.description: Client overrides applied when the widget is created. Console settings load first; boot payload fields override them.

fields.name: pluginKey
fields.description: Channel/tenant ID (required).

fields.name: locale
fields.description: 'en' | 'ko' | 'ja' | 'it' | 'de' | 'fr' | 'zh-TW' | 'es'. Overrides Console language for widget UI and stream API (init + messages).

fields.name: gaTrackingId
fields.description: GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). Overrides Console ga_tracking_id. PRO or ENTERPRISE plan required.

fields.name: userEmail
fields.description: Stored with chats/messages; sent to stream API.

fields.name: userPhotoURL
fields.description: User photo URL; sent to stream API when provided.

fields.name: colorCode
fields.description: Theme hex color override.

fields.name: buttonText
fields.description: Floating trigger label.

fields.name: welcomeMessage
fields.description: Assistant welcome message for new chats.

fields.name: coverImage
fields.description: Drawer header cover image URL.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Channel description in drawer.

fields.name: imgUrl
fields.description: Trigger logo URL when buttonText empty.

update.description: Runtime overrides. All optional. Same channel settings fields in camelCase.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: 'en' | 'ko' | 'ja' | 'it' | 'de' | 'fr' | 'zh-TW' | 'es'. Change language after boot or before boot (queued).

fields.name: dataset_ids
fields.description: RAG dataset IDs. Applied to init (warmup) and message stream requests until changed. Sent as datasetIds to the stream API.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: 'floating' | 'overlay-fullscreen' | 'push-sidebar'. Default from Console.

fields.name: workspaceName
fields.description: Panel header name. Locale default if empty (e.g. Chat / 채팅).

fields.name: contentSelector
fields.description: push-sidebar wrapper selector. Auto-detects #app, #root, #__next, #__nuxt, #q-app, main, etc.

fields.name: colorCode
fields.description: Theme hex color.

fields.name: buttonText
fields.description: Floating trigger label (pill button).

fields.name: welcomeMessage
fields.description: Assistant welcome message for new chats.

fields.name: coverImage
fields.description: Drawer header cover image URL.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Channel description in drawer.

fields.name: imgUrl
fields.description: Trigger logo URL when buttonText empty.

fields.name: userEmail
fields.description: Stored with chats/messages; sent to stream API.

fields.name: hideTrigger
fields.description: Hide floating button; use open from your UI.

fields.name: pluginKey
fields.description: If different from current, triggers re-boot.

open.description: Optional payload when opening the panel

fields.name: dataset_ids
fields.description: RAG dataset IDs for this open session. Overrides update default. Sent as datasetIds to stream API. Omit for backend auto-select.

layoutModes.description: Floating button bottom-right; panel ~380×600px desktop, fullscreen on mobile.
Pushes main content; use contentSelector for SPAs. Mobile uses overlay-fullscreen.

gaEvents.description: When gaTrackingId (boot or Console) on PRO/ENTERPRISE.

integration.scriptPlacement: head or before </body>. Use defer + queue stub + boot in one snippet.
integration.spaHandling: destroy then boot after route changes if body is replaced.
integration.allowDomain: Console allow_domain list blocks boot on disallowed hostnames. Empty allows all. frontierbase.io always allowed.
integration.csp: script-src cdn.frontierbase.io; connect-src googleapis.com, firebaseio.com, *.a.run.app; img-src for asset URLs. UI uses Shadow DOM, not iframe.
integration.localeAndDatasets: Pass locale in boot for the initial language (widget UI + stream API). Pass dataset_ids in update for the default RAG scope on init and messages, or in open to scope a single panel session.
